Historical newspaper election import

Imported November 6, 2026. Contemporary Deseret News returns are unofficial. Names, party labels and write-in status follow the published entries. Outcomes are unverified. Unknown or illegible tallies are shown as —, not zero. Subtotals include only known votes for listed options; unnamed write-ins are not invented as people.

Coverage by source year

Year and sourceJurisdictionsCandidate appearancesCandidate contestsMeasures

School-district measures are shown on their county pages with the district named in the contest. Historical Hiawatha, Sunnyside and Ophir records are retained. Salt Lake County is excluded from the 1991 article; other missing places or races are source gaps, not evidence that elections did not occur.

Source limitations and unresolved entries

  • 1989 · Alpine: Stephen Denler: negative printed tally retained as unknown
  • 1989 · Emery: Glenys C. Sitterud: printed tally 7O is ambiguous; vote count is unknown.
  • 1989 · Virgin: Names published without vote counts; outcomes remain unverified.
  • 1989 · Virgin: Names published without vote counts; outcomes remain unverified.
  • 1991 · Enterprise: Source begins mid-contest; office and full candidate name are missing
  • 1993 · Henrieville: Unnamed write-in recipients are omitted; reported named-candidate subtotal is incomplete.
  • 1993 · Henrieville: Unnamed write-in recipients are omitted; reported named-candidate subtotal is incomplete.
